notes_for_editor: Only source is OSM node 5718680680. Two searches (Lehigh Mountain, South Mountain, Lehigh County) found no lookout by this name. Search snippets mention a 'The Lookout' atop South Mountain in Bethlehem; that is a different landmark, unverified and not cited. The local GNIS file (not cited) puts the nearest named summit, Lehigh Mountain, about 4.6 km away, so the node is not clearly on a named peak. Ownership is unknown; the name suggests a City of Allentown link, which is not confirmed. Status 'standing' is unverified.
